title: Valvetronic Eccentric Shaft Sensor Reference Plausibility
meaning: DME detected inconsistent angular position comparison between eccentric shaft magnetic sensors.
symptoms: Engine operates on emergency throttle valve control
inspectionSteps: Inspect eccentric shaft sensor connector for oil soaking from valve cover.
verifiedFixes: Replace valve cover gasket and eccentric shaft seal
Relearn Valvetronic stops via ISTA / tool

title: Fuel Control Mixture Lean (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
meaning: BMW DME short-term and long-term fuel trim adaption limit reached on Bank 1.
symptoms: Engine idle surge / stall on cold morning
inspectionSteps: Smoke test intake system (common DISA valve O-ring, upper/lower intake boots, CCV oil separator hoses).
Check fuel pressure at Schrader rail test port.
verifiedFixes: Replace torn lower intake boot / DISA valve O-ring
Replace failing CCV oil separator crankcase breather hoses

title: Secondary Air Injection System Bank 1 Flow Fault
meaning: Pre-cat O2 sensor did not register expected lean shift during cold-start secondary air injection pump operation.
inspectionSteps: Listen for vacuum cleaner sound from electric air pump on cold start.
Inspect secondary air check valve for carbon clogging.
verifiedFixes: Replace dry-rotted vacuum lines to secondary air valve
